notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 2.4
notes.notes:
Merry Chrismas to that one guy who really hated seeing Chel do her little puzzle-solving dance.

Version 2.4 - December 22, 2024
 Added option to disable Chel and friends' animations during puzzles.

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Today we have some updates to the final boss, including a bugfix that I think was maybe introduced in one of the 2.X updates. Hopefully this resolves the issue:

Version 2.3 - December 20, 2022
Fixed issue with no items medal not unlocking during the final boss.
Final boss HP down from six hearts to five.
Added additional five seconds to attack phase.

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 2.2
notes.notes:
This version introduces more fixes to the Japanese translation based on user feedback.

Version 2.2 - February 25, 2022
Further adjustments to Japanese translation.
Fixed buttons for scrolling lore entries showing off-screen in Japanese version.

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.6 coming at you with a few minor fixes. Depending on your system, it may fix any fps issues you've been having.

Version 1.6 - April 11, 2021
Fixed timing issue causing the game to lock at 50 fps on some systems.
Fixed typo in credits.
Added functionality to enable/disable an FPS counter with F4.

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.5
notes.notes:
A new version of Khimera: Puzzle Island has been released today bringing with it a host of changes and additions dedicated to improving the keyboard/game pad experience.

Version 1.5 - March 23, 2021
Added functionality for EMPTY and NOTE buttons to close the achievement menu.
Added option to adjust cursor speed in puzzles.
Defaults for cursor speeds set to 25 and 5 from 30 and 6 for initial delay and subsequent delays respectively.
Fixed not being able to select hints with keyboard/game pad when auto-hints are off.

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 has been released! This version features a new mechanic where the mouse cursor will affix itself to the x or y axis, allowing you to place markers in straight lines. If this kind of straight-edge lifestyle is absolutely not your style, you can disable this new mechanic in the settings menu.

Version 1.3 - December 7, 2020
Wow more typos who would have ever guessed?Fixed discrepancy between all medals achievement check and gold medal display on puzzle menu.Fixed a few mosaic tiles that had more than one answer.Added auto-ruler, a mechanic which locks the cursor to the x or y axis when using the mouse, allowing you to easily place straight lines (can be deactivated in settings).

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is now available! On top of a few more bug fixes, I've also added a few requested features including the ability to get through the victory fanfare quicker and an option to turn off text sounds. Thank you very much for your feedback and for playing my game!

I would also like to take a moment to let you guys know that the entire OST has been uploaded to YouTube for your listening pleasure. The videos were put together using the MP3s available via the official Soundtrack release on Steam so if you like what you hear, consider picking them up to have on the go:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469770/Khimera_Puzzle_Island_Soundtrack/

Version 1.2 - December 3, 2020
More typos un-typo'd.Fixed pressing Escape on mosaic menu closing the game.Added missing tooltip to mouse button config in controls menu.Fixed being able to select locked puzzles and stages with keyboard controls.Fixed bug where game would lock up after doing a mosaic puzzle then going back to story mode.Fixed crash on piece selection menu related to keyboard controls.Fixed Chelshia's lore entry being available before it was intended to be unlocked.Fixed shop's opening dialogue remaining after exiting the shop.Added tooltips to the puzzle select menu.Added option to disable text sound effects.You can now skip through the win sequence by left clicking or pressing the assigned 'fill marker' button (default: A).

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 is now live featuring a few small fixes to the shop and some spelling errors. Big thanks to everyone on the discord who's been pointing things out to me!


Version 1.1 - December 1, 2020
Fixed some typos.Fixed cursor vanishing on the right side of wide puzzles.Fixed shop not selling items if you had exactly enough cookies.Fixed pieces in shop displaying incorrectly as an empty marker instead of a note and vice versa.On boot, the game will now detect the largest possible resolution that will fit the display and default to that, rather than defaulting to 1x (if you've not already set a preference).
